title: Distinct transverse-response signatures of retained-spin, eliminated-spin, and polynomial Burnett-type surrogate closures
summary: High-curvature observables in incompressible flows, including $k^4$-weighted spectra, can arise from explicit internal rotation, elimination of a fast spin variable, or polynomial higher-gradient closure. Building on a retained-spin micropolar closure derived separately from the Boltzmann--Curtiss equation, we show that these mechanisms are dynamically distinguishable in transverse linear response.
